dialogs.about: 할아버지와 아침에 창밖 날씨를 보며 이야기

lines.en: Good morning. Did you hear the forecast today?
Yes, the radio said rain and thunder tonight.
lines.ko: 네, 라디오에서 오늘 밤에 비하고 천둥이 온댔어요.

lines.en: Oh my. The air feels humid and heavy now.
A soft breeze comes through the open window.
Will you close it before the drizzle starts?
lines.ko: 이슬비가 오기 전에 창문 닫아 줄래요?

lines.en: Sure. I see lightning far over the mountain.
lines.ko: 그럼요. 산 너머 멀리 번개가 보여요.

lines.en: Last winter we had hail and heavy frost.
I remember. The morning was very chilly then.
Do you think a rainbow will come later?
Maybe. Grandma, thank you for opening the curtain.
lines.ko: 아마요. 할머니, 커튼 열어 줘서 고마워요.

lines.en: Hi. The forecast said drizzle this afternoon.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 예보에서 오늘 오후에 이슬비가 온댔어요.

lines.en: Hi. Really? Then I will bring my laundry in.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 정말요? 그럼 빨래를 안으로 들여놓을게요.

lines.en: Good idea. The air is humid and warm.
Did you hear thunder in the night?
Yes, and lightning flashed twice before morning.
lines.ko: 네, 아침 전에 번개가 두 번 번쩍했어요.

lines.en: It was loud. Was there hail too?
A little hail fell on my roof then.
lines.ko: 그때 우리 지붕에 우박이 조금 떨어졌어요.

lines.en: Oh dear. This morning felt chilly to me.
Yes, the wind was cold this morning.
Thank you for telling me. Look, a rainbow!
